description: A single field that can only hold the phases a flow really has, e.g. `'review' | 'submitting' | 'done'`. Replaces combinations of booleans.
A combination of values that the UI should never show, such as `isSubmitting && isDone`. Good modeling makes it unrepresentable.
A union of objects sharing a literal `type` field. Checking `type` tells you (and TypeScript) which payload exists.
A map from status to the events it accepts and the function that computes the next state.
An action named in the past tense after what happened (`orderFailed`), letting the reducer decide its meaning.
